$sources: ACI 318-19 Sec 16.4 (horizontal shear of composite concrete flexural members), 9.6.3.4 (least ties)
source: ACI 318-19 Sec 16.4 (the same numbers as the extended pack's)

sources.roughenedLimit: ACI 318-19 Table 16.4.4.2(c): no ties, intentionally roughened, clean: Vnh <= 0.55 bv d
sources.tiedSmoothLimit: ACI 318-19 Table 16.4.4.2(b): minimum ties, not roughened, clean: Vnh <= 0.55 bv d
sources.roughenedTied: ACI 318-19 Table 16.4.4.2(a): ties and a surface roughened to about 6 mm: Vnh = λ (1.8 + 0.6 ρv fy) bv d <= 3.5 bv d; above φ 3.5 bv d shear friction by 22.9 (16.4.4.5)
sources.minTies: ACI 318-19 16.4.6.1 with 9.6.3.4: Av,min = 0.062 √f'c bw s / fyt, at least 0.35 bw s / fyt
sources.tieSpacing: ACI 318-19 16.4.7.2: ties at most four times the least dimension of the supported element and 600 mm apart
sources.tension: ACI 318-19 16.4.4.4 (tension across the contact surface: shear by contact only with the minimum ties)
